name: The Fruit Loop
schedule: The first Friday of every month, starting Fri, Dec 4, 2026. Meet 6:30 pm at the rainbow crosswalk at Central Ave and Portland St; it rolls at 7:00 pm and is back about 9:45 pm.

start_location.name: The rainbow crosswalk at Central Ave and Portland St
start_location.address: N Central Ave and W Portland St, Phoenix, AZ 85004

pace: About 10 to 12 mph, flat. Nobody gets dropped.
founded_note: The first ride is Fri, Dec 4, 2026.
visitor_notes: Lights are required: white on the front, red on the back. It's dark by the start from fall to spring. 18 and up. No sign-up. Nobody is in a photo unless they take a "Photos OK" sticker at the start.
description: A queer social night ride through Phoenix's history, hosted by Robert Castan of Cycle for Change. About 24 flat miles from the 2018 rainbow crosswalk at Central and Portland: down Washington Street on the route of the first Pride march in 1981, out to Greenwood Memory Lawn, through the old west-side neighborhoods to the Melrose Curve and Charlie's, Steele Indian School Park and Coronado, and home on the old Fruit Loop bar circuit. No-drop, free.
evidence: Robert Castan hosts it. On Oct 23, 2026 he set the first ride for Fri, Dec 4, 2026, then the first Friday of every month: meet 6:30 pm, roll 7:00 pm at the Central and Portland rainbow crosswalk, about 24 miles (22 to 25), no-drop.

refresh.notes: Robert's own ride. Re-check by asking him; /fruitloop/ is its page.
